line: Bitcoin drifting lower on persistent oversold technicals and broad selling across the asset class, while whale flows suggest accumulation into the drawdown.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -0.94% on the day, spot ETF net -411.9M USD (Nov 6, 2026), Fear & Greed 28 (fear), funding +0.0025% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: US Treasury moved to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows tied to Iran and Russia.
Binance told users in Spain, France, and Poland to withdraw assets by Dec 31 or face account closure and retroactive fees starting Nov 29.
Web3Auth moved $5.6 million from exposed Keplr wallets to prevent theft, but some funds were already stolen from affected users.
